_comment: Local settings. Copy this file to config.local.json to override without touching git history — config.local.json is gitignored.

localFolder._comment: Where exports land on disk. If dropboxPath is set and exists, files are ALSO copied there, organized as <dropboxPath>/<PageName>/Carousel/<YYYY-MM-DD>/. Leave dropboxPath empty to skip Dropbox entirely.

dropboxApi._comment: Used only when export.mode = 'dropbox-api' (e.g. once this is hosted on a VPS without the Dropbox desktop client). Set DROPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN as an environment variable instead of writing it here.

render._comment: Leave chromiumExecutablePath empty to use Playwright's own downloaded browser (normal setup after `npx playwright install chromium` in server/). Only set this if you need to point at a specific Chrome/Chromium binary.

video._comment: ffmpeg must be installed and on PATH (brew install ffmpeg / apt install ffmpeg), or point ffmpegPath at a binary directly. crf is x264's quality dial: lower = higher quality + bigger file. 16 is visually lossless for this kind of content; 0 is mathematically lossless (very large files) if you ever want an archival master before a platform re-compresses it anyway.
